abstract: We treated 6 patients with non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumor (NSEGCT) by VP-16 + ifosfamide + cisplatin (VIP) chemotherapy as an induction therapy to investigate the effectiveness and safety. Primary lesions were located at the mediastinum in 4 patients and the retroperitoneum in 2 patients. As a rule, all patients were treated with VIP chemotherapy of 4 courses with or without second-line treatment such as chemotherapy, residual tumor resection and/or radiation. Following the induction therapy (VIP), 4 of 6 patients (67%) achieved complete or partial responses. After salvage therapy, 4 patients (67%) achieved complete responses and two other patients also achieved partial responses. However, only 2 of the 5 patients who had been follow-up for more than 2 years have remained disease free. The effects of VIP chemotherapy on non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumor appeared to be similar to those of the conventional chemotherapies though the number of patients was small in the current study. It appears to be necessary to design more effective regimen.
abstract_ja: 「非セミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍（NSEGCT）6例に対し、導入療法としてVP-16、イホスファミド、シスプラチン（VIP）化学療法を施行し、有効性と安全性を検討した。原発巣は縦隔が4例、後腹膜が2例であった。原則として全例にVIP療法を4コース施行し、必要に応じて化学療法の追加、残存腫瘍の切除および／または放射線療法などの二次治療を行った。導入療法（VIP）後に6例中4例（67%）が完全奏効または部分奏効を得た。救援療法後には4例（67%）が完全奏効に至り、さらに2例が部分奏効を得た。しかし、2年以上フォローアップできた5例のうち無病生存を維持しているのは2例のみであった。症例数は少ないものの、VIP化学療法の効果は従来の化学療法と同程度と考えられた。より有効なレジメンの開発が必要である。」
